messages:
jiho: dropping a quick UX IDEA: in Prompt Sets view, add a per-group action menu with `Review group`, `Bulk approve visible`, and `Open all diffs` so teams dont have to select dozens of checkboxes. prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/group-actions len: nice. one thing to call out: bulk actions must be explicit about scope. `Bulk approve visible` should show a confirm modal listing the number of items and the active filter. otherwise folks might accidentally approve hidden failures. aisha: a11y point: modals must trap focus and announce summary like "Confirm bulk approve, 12 items will be approved". Also we need an accessible label on the group menu like `Options for Checkout flow tests`. sam: microcopy: instead of `Bulk approve visible` try `Approve visible tests (12)` so the count is inline. reduces cognitive burden. Also for the menu label, `Group options` is too vague. Use `Checkout flow group actions`. maria: visual suggestion: add a subtle divider between group header and first row with an affordance line when grouped. helps scan. Also consider a collapsed-preview line that shows top 2 diffs summary (e.g., "3 regressions, 2 improvements") so you can triage without expanding everything. jiho: love the collapsed-preview. Implementation note: that preview needs live counts from run data; avoid computing on the client for very large sets. we should add an API flag `includeGroupSummary=true`. aisha: keyboard shortcut proposal: when a group header is focused, `Enter` expands, `Shift+Enter` expands and moves focus to first diff; `A` opens group action menu. document these in the keyboard help overlay. len: perf caveat: expanding many groups could cause lots of DOM nodes. let's virtualize children and render a placeholder skeleton while items load. also maintain scroll position when toggling many groups. PERF ticket: PERF-1001. sam: copy tweak for the approval confirmation modal: headline `Approve N tests` -> `Approve N test results` (results clarify these are outcomes not test definitions). Add secondary line: `This will mark the selected results as approved for this run.` maria: QA note: when a reviewer uses `Approve visible tests (12)` we should emit an event `promptset.bulk_approve` with metadata: promptset_id, run_id, count, user_id — for analytics and revert workflows. jiho: accessibility detail: use `aria-live=polite` region for the group collapse/expand so screen readers hear counts updating but avoid verbose announcements on every hover. also ensure `role=button` on header toggle and set tabindex. small example: ```
...
``` len: one more microcopy ask: legend label `Failures` -> `Failure diffs` and `Neutral` -> `No change` to reduce ambiguity for new users. aisha: i'll draft the A11Y checklist items and add keyboard walkthrough to the PR template. planning to file A11Y-199 for the aria-live/announce work. jiho: will make a Fig update with both designs: (A) group actions in header, collapsed preview + count, and (B) inline selection + dense table. can we decide default? my vote: A for Prompt Sets page, B for Run Results. maria: agree. please link tickets to the fig frames and add acceptance criteria: keyboard focus order, announcement copy, analytics event, and confirm modal copy. product-bot: Created ticket UI-4310 and A11Y-199. Assigned UI-4310 to jiho and A11Y-199 to aisha. :white_check_mark: sam: thanks everyone. next step: jiho drop frames by EOD and i'll pair on the confirm modal copy before it lands.
